appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'
Legend label: 'Low' at bottom, 'High' at top
Legend scale: color gradient from dark red (0) to yellow (100)
State WV is shaded dark red, indicating the highest incidence level on the map
State UT is shaded dark red, indicating the highest incidence level on the map
State AL is shaded orange, indicating a moderate incidence level on the map

printed_facts.fact: State WV color corresponds to the darkest red on the scale, indicating a value near 0
State UT color corresponds to the darkest red on the scale, indicating a value near 0
State AL color corresponds to the orange band on the scale, indicating a value between 40 and 60
